newsitem.title: USA: BankUnited sets $20 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: BankUnited sets $20 mln private placement.

text.p: BankUnited Financial Corp said on Monday that its BankUnited Capital sold an additional $20 million of new preferred stock through a second private placement of redeemable trust preferred shares.
This sale constitutes a further issuance of the $50 million in securities sold by the company in December 1996, BankUnited said.
The redeemable trust preferred securities have a par value of $1,000 and a coupon of 10.25 percent to a total of $70 million.
The securities pay interest semiannually beginning June 30, 1997.
Proceeds from the sale will be available for general corporate purposes, including capital contributions to BankUnited FSB, the company said.
